subject: Re: Embedded demo — AWS SI calendar handback and fallback slots
messages:
From: James Lo <james.lo@brightline.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cloudops.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Embedded demo - AWS SI coordination

Hi Michael + Vanessa,

Quick heads-up: our SI lead (Priya) is going to be out of the office next week unexpectedly and wants to hand back the technical host role for the embedded demo with AWS Marketplace on 9/10. Brightline can still present the product portion, but we need Redwood or the SI enablement team to run the deep technical walkthrough and answer infra/permissions questions. Attached is the runbook (demo-runbook-v1.pdf) and a short checklist.

Can someone from Redwood pick up the technical host responsibilities? If not, can we move the demo to one of these fallback windows (all UTC):
- 2027-09-13 09:00-10:00 UTC
- 2027-09-13 16:00-17:00 UTC
- 2027-09-14 07:00-08:00 UTC

We'd rather avoid pushing beyond next week because AWS marketplace approval needs the recording and a short follow-up.

Thanks,
James Lo
Partnerships, Brightline Systems
Attachment: demo-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF)
From: michael_grant@redwood.ai
To: James Lo <james.lo@brightline.com>, AWS Marketplace Enablement <marketplace-enable@amazon.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-08T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded demo - AWS SI coordination

James — thanks for the note and the runbook.

Short answer: we can cover the technical walkthrough from Redwood side. Vanessa can host the live session for EMEA-friendly hours; I'll cover the setup and permissions portion and Kar thik can jump on the infra deep-dive. Kimberly will own the marketplace checklist and ensure we capture the recording/consent.

Proposed plan (action items):
- Michael: confirm technical host script + join as primary technical lead (I will) — by 9/09 EOD PT.
- Vanessa: host live meeting and do intro + Q&A — confirmed availability for fallback slot 2027-09-13 16:00 UTC.
- Kar thik: prepare infra runbook notes and be on standby for deep questions.
- Kimberly: confirm AWS marketplace prep & deliverables (AWS checklist attached).

If AWS Marketplace confirms the 2027-09-13 16:00 UTC slot, we'll go with that and Brightline can handle the product narrative. If they need a morning slot, Vanessa can also host 2027-09-14 07:00 UTC but that means Michael or Karthik will need to be available earlier.

Requests for AWS team: please confirm which slot you can lock and whether you require a doc signature (DocuSign) for the recording/permissions. I added a link to the runbook on Drive here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB_demo_runbook

Thanks — I'll update the MAP (mutual action plan) after we lock the slot.

—Michael Grant
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachment: aws-checklist.xlsx (Excel)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai, James Lo <james.lo@brightline.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-09T06:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded demo - AWS SI coordination

Michael / James — I can take the host role for the 16:00 UTC fallback on 9/13. A couple of quick notes:

- I'll need the participant list and the final run of show by 9/12 18:00 UTC so I can tailor the opening and slide deck intro.
- Suggest we add a 10-minute warm-up call (15 minutes before the demo) for speaker mics and for the SI to confirm the live environment.
- If AWS needs a morning EMEA/EMEA+APAC slot instead, I can cover 9/14 07:00 UTC but prefer the 9/13 16:00 UTC window.

I'll also add the fallback windows to the MAP and include a pre-call checklist. Here's a short proposed run-of-show items to include in the warm-up:
- 15m pre-call: mic checks + environment sanity check
- 45m demo: Brightline product + Redwood infra Q&A (split: 25 / 20)
- 15m wrap: next steps & recording consents

James — please confirm final attendees & any AWS-specific questions you want us to prioritize.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: AWS Marketplace Enablement <marketplace-enable@amazon.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai, James Lo <james.lo@brightline.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-09T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded demo - AWS SI coordination

Thanks for the fast follow-up. 9/13 16:00 UTC works from the Marketplace side — we've booked the slot and added a short compliance check before the demo. We do require a signed acknowledgement for the recording and data handling consent; please route via DocuSign.

Action items for Redwood/Brightline:
- Michael: upload the final runbook and recording consent to the DocuSign packet (link below) by 9/10 23:59 UTC.
- Vanessa: join the 15-minute pre-call at 15:45 UTC on 9/13 for the mic/env check.
- Brightline: confirm final attendee list and any slides that reference AWS trademarks.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/12345-aws-slot-confirm
AWS Marketplace Enablement
Attachment: marketplace-preflight.pdf (PDF)
